change: FOLLOW-1397: the digit rules read a number followed by a multiplier word (tys./k/K/thousand/mil, mln/M/m/million/millones/milion…, mld/miliard/bn/billion) as the multiplied value, so "1,15 mln PLN" is grounded by 1150000 and "€750K" by "€750,000". The value must equal a number of the listing, or (with three or more significant digits written) equal it rounded to the precision written. Inputs, raw outputs and prompt digests are v15's byte for byte; only the expected record below differs.
